voice_description: Warm, measured documentary narrator; calm and curious, gentle authority.

utterances.text:
Welcome to the garden tour.
Today, Doctor NWIN shows us three rare plants.

The TOOB-rohz blooms in a nineteen-nineties style,
and the ruh-NUNK-yoo-luss needs twelve percent more light.

NAH-suh studied the yoo-kuh-LIP-tuss at three forty-five each day,
spending five dollars per sample.
